images.title: 電池（風格基準，先生成）
images.prompt: Scientific illustration in the manner of a 19th-century physics textbook (Ganot's 'Elements of Physics'): fine steel-engraving line work with cross-hatching, lightly hand-coloured in faded watercolour washes (brass, mahogany, porcelain white, muted red and slate blue) on warm off-white paper tone. Precise, restrained, instructive; not glossy, not 3D-rendered, no cartoon outlines. Laboratory apparatus as it really looks and works: correct proportions, visible terminals, screws and wires; no invented parts. Presentation: one isolated subject for a die-cut pop-up book. Flat front elevation, straight-on orthographic view, no perspective, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no background scenery, even neutral daylight. Centred on a plain pure white background, with a generous empty margin all around; nothing touches the image edges. Subject: a single large dry-cell battery standing upright, cylindrical zinc can with a paper wrapper, brass positive cap on top and a terminal screw. Absolutely no writing anywhere: no Chinese characters, letters, numbers, seals, signatures, watermarks or frames. Every signboard, plaque and banner is blank.
